deviations_from_adr: AC-10/FF-CELL-NO-UUID (ADR §2.5): ADR-текст для formatCellValue(value,'file') читается как синхронный 'originalName | fallback id' (по паттерну person, который честно фолбэчит на id). Реализовано СТРОЖЕ: введён FILE_CELL_ASYNC-сентинел (records-form.js, зеркало RELATION_CELL_ASYNC) — formatCellValue НИКОГДА не возвращает сырой fileVersionId, только сентинел/имя/«—»; имя резолвится асинхронно через листинг записи (GET /api/records/:id/files) в новых компонентах FileCell (список) и FileFieldValue (карточка), по паттерну RelationCell/RelationFieldValue. Причина: AC-9/AC-10/FF-CELL-NO-UUID явно требуют «никогда не показывать сырой uuid», а person может честно фолбэчить на id (не такое же требование в его AC), file — нет. Это ужесточение приёмочного критерия в духе §4.3 (formatCellValue → resolved originalName), не ослабление и не расхождение по объёму.

Тестовый инфраструктурный фикс (src/__tests__/files-http.test.ts): существующий helper httpGet() отбрасывал query-string (path: parsed.pathname без parsed.search) — до T-0579 ни один тест этого файла не использовал query-параметры, поэтому баг был латентным. Без правки AC-11-тесты (?disposition=inline) не могли пройти ни при какой реализации маршрута (клиент их физически не отправлял бы). Правка аддитивна (path: pathname+search); все 19 существовавших тестов файла остаются зелёными без изменения ожиданий (перепроверено).

FIX-FORWARD (review B1): GET /api/records/:recordId/files response gains a `versionIds: string[]` field (PgFileStore.listFilesByRecord + FakeFileStore mirror) — EVERY version id a file has ever had, not just currentVersionId. Additive, non-breaking (existing consumers ignore unknown fields); required to close review m1 honestly (a superseded-but-real fileVersionId must still resolve to its file's name, not read as 'not found').

FIX-FORWARD (review C2/AC-15): the e2e journey-runner's closed StepAction vocabulary had no way to drive a native <select> (Playwright's fill() throws on it — verified empirically) or capture a value from the field-type dropdown needed to author a file-typed field for the new ux-file-field journey. Added ONE new closed-vocabulary action, `selectOption` (types.ts/loader.ts/runner.ts/loader.test.ts/README.md), per this file's own stated 'reviewed extension' convention — not an ad-hoc escape hatch. Also added `combobox` to the RoleName union (native <select> accessible role) so the new journey can target the dropdown by role+name.

FE-T0579-3: первая версия fitness-гейта FF-CATALOG (ci/checks/file-field-catalog-isolation.sh) ложно-положительно ловила легитимное использование `contractKind === 'file'` в screen-app-records.jsx (нужно ТОЛЬКО чтобы прокинуть recordId в field-дескриптор перед вызовом единого <FieldControl>, не для выбора другого компонента-рендерера). Заменил grep-предикат на awk-паттерн, который ищет именно форму «contractKind===file» → «return (<НЕ-FieldControl»; проверено адверс-пробой (искусственно вставленный параллельный диспатч детектится, легитимный код — не детектится, ложных срабатываний нет).

FE-T0579-4 (fix-forward): the test tier for web/** is vitest 'node' environment with NO jsdom (web/vitest.config.js — explicit, documented architecture decision: 'no jsdom overhead, honest'). This means (a) React hooks (useState/useEffect) cannot be exercised by calling a component function directly outside a real render — verified empirically ('Invalid hook call' error) — and (b) there is no DOM to dispatch a real change-event with a File on an <input type=file>. Resolved AC-7/M2 by extracting the upload's core logic into a standalone, React-free, exported async function (uploadFileToRecord in field-renderer.jsx) that IS directly testable with a real `File` (Node 22 native global) + mocked fetch — genuinely exercises the request shape (method/headers/body) and the replace-flow (2nd call returns a new versionId), without needing jsdom or react-test-renderer (neither is installed; adding jsdom was judged out of proportion for a fix-forward pass given the repo's stated zero-dep-growth culture — see memory demiurge-conventions).

FE-T0579-5 (fix-forward, C2/AC-15): confirmed empirically (headless Chromium probe) that Playwright's locator.fill() throws 'Element is not an <input>, <textarea> or [contenteditable] element' on a native <select> — the field-type dropdown ('Тип поля', screen-app-schema.jsx) needed for the new file-field journey could not be driven by the existing `fill` action. Added a minimal `selectOption` action to the shared journey-runner vocabulary (see deviations_from_adr) rather than leave the journey undriveable.

tails: AC-9/AC-15 residual: the vitest web tier is a documented, intentional 'node' environment with NO jsdom (web/vitest.config.js: 'no jsdom overhead, honest') and neither jsdom nor react-test-renderer is installed. Verified empirically that calling a hooks-bearing component function directly throws ('Invalid hook call') — so FileFieldValue's/FileCell's/FileField's async fetch→setState transitions cannot be exercised end-to-end at the unit level without adding a new dependency (judged out of proportion for a fix-forward pass given the repo's zero-dep-growth culture). Mitigated for AC-7 by extracting the upload's pure logic (uploadFileToRecord) into a directly-testable function; AC-9's preview-safety logic is fully covered via the extracted isPreviewSafeMime helper. The REMAINING gap is the fetch/setState wiring itself (loading→resolved/notfound/forbidden transitions) — only structurally asserted, not behaviorally executed. Recommend: either add jsdom scoped to a new vitest workspace project for exactly this class of component, or a live browser smoke pass on the dev stand.
